sloka: अग्राह्य वीर्यः पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतः सुखः ।संरक्तः किंचिद् आपाण्डुः आतपः शोभते क्षितौ ॥३-१६-१९॥
transliteration: agrāhya vīryaḥ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne sparśataḥ sukhaḥ ।saṁraktaḥ kiṁcid āpāṇḍuḥ ātapaḥ śobhate kṣitau ॥3-16-19॥

translations.english: The heat of the Sun which we do not feel in the forenoon is comfortable during midday when the Sun shines slightly reddish white on earth.
